steps.name: bootstrap-test-environment
steps.run:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends ca-certificates git nodejs python3-pip python3-venv >/tmp/apt-install.log 2>&1
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet -r requirements-dev.txt playwright==1.55.0
python -m pip check
if ! python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium >/tmp/playwright-install.log 2>&1; then
  tail -n 200 /tmp/playwright-install.log
  exit 1
fi
tail -n 40 /tmp/playwright-install.log
python --version
python -c "import PIL; print('Pillow', PIL.__version__)"
node --version
ruff --version
pytest --version

steps.name: apply-validate-and-publish-readable-coverage
steps.run:
set -Eeuo pipefail
PATCH=.local_relay/patches/issue-36-readable-coverage.patch
test -s "$PATCH"
git apply --check "$PATCH"
git apply "$PATCH"
node --check app/static/pages.js
node --check app/static/vi-editor-component-fit.js
node --check app/static/vi-editor-runtime-fixes.js
python3 -m py_compile scripts/readable_diagram_contact_sheet.py scripts/real_vi_readability_browser_test.py tests/test_readable_diagram_density_contract.py
. .venv/bin/activate
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR="$PWD/artifacts/readable-diagram-density"
export WORK_ROOT="$PWD/.sandbox-pytest-jobs"
rm -rf "$BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR" "$WORK_ROOT"
mkdir -p "$BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR" "$WORK_ROOT"
LOG="$BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR/full-validation.log"
set +e
bash scripts/sandbox_readable_diagram_test.sh >"$LOG" 2>&1
status=$?
set -e
OUT="$PWD/.local_relay/output"
rm -rf "$OUT"
mkdir -p "$OUT/evidence" "$OUT/patched/app/static" "$OUT/patched/scripts" "$OUT/patched/tests"
find "$BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.json' -exec cp {} "$OUT/evidence/" \;
grep -v -E '^(SEMANTIC_.*_JSON|REAL_VI_READABILITY_JSON|READABLE_CONTACT_SHEET_B64_)' "$LOG" >"$OUT/evidence/full-validation.log" || true
for name in readable-diagram-contact-sheet.jpg readable-basic-1440x900.png readable-flow-1440x900.png readable-huge-overview-1440x900.png real-readability-block-1440x900.png real-readability-1440x900.png; do
  if test -s "$BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR/$name"; then cp "$BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR/$name" "$OUT/evidence/"; fi
done
cp app/static/pages.js "$OUT/patched/app/static/"
cp app/static/vi-editor-component-fit.js "$OUT/patched/app/static/"
cp app/static/vi-editor-runtime-fixes.js "$OUT/patched/app/static/"
cp scripts/readable_diagram_contact_sheet.py "$OUT/patched/scripts/"
cp scripts/real_vi_readability_browser_test.py "$OUT/patched/scripts/"
cp tests/test_readable_diagram_density_contract.py "$OUT/patched/tests/"
VALIDATION_STATUS="$status" python3 - <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
out = Path('.local_relay/output')
evidence = out / 'evidence'
summary = {'status': int(os.environ['VALIDATION_STATUS']), 'diagnostics': []}
for path in sorted(evidence.glob('*.json')):
    try:
        value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    except Exception as exc:
        summary['diagnostics'].append({'path': path.name, 'parse_error': str(exc)})
        continue
    item = {'path': path.name}
    for key in ('failures', 'console_errors', 'page_errors'):
        if isinstance(value.get(key), list):
            item[key] = value[key]
    summary['diagnostics'].append(item)
(out / 'validation-status.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
entries = []
for path in sorted(p for p in out.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name != 'manifest.json'):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    entries.append({'path': path.relative_to(out).as_posix(), 'bytes': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
(out / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'files': entries}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print('VALIDATION_COMPACT=' + json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')))
print(json.dumps({'evidence_files': len(entries), 'evidence_bytes': sum(item['bytes'] for item in entries)}, separators=(',', ':')))
PY
grep -v -E '^(SEMANTIC_.*_JSON|REAL_VI_READABILITY_JSON|READABLE_CONTACT_SHEET_B64_)' "$LOG" | tail -n 160 || true
find "$OUT" -type f -printf '%P %s bytes\n' | sort
exit "$status"
